subject: Intro demo + security walkthrough for NovaCorp Health
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novacorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — onboarding + security folks?

Hi Jasmine / Sean —

We signed up via the self-serve trial and have a couple of teams who want a short walkthrough: product owners, the AE/SE to show the flow, and our IT/security lead to confirm data handling and network requirements. Goal: 30–40 minute demo + 10 min Q&A. Ideally next week but we have a few constraints:

- Primary users in Boston (ET) and a small ops team in Dublin (GMT).
- IT/security prefers afternoons ET (14:00–17:00 ET).

Can you propose a couple of slots that include someone who can speak to integrations and security? Also happy to send a short security questionnaire if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Product, NovaCorp Health
elena.morris@novacorp.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novacorp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — onboarding + security folks?

Hi Elena —

Thanks for signing up and for the details. Sean is our AE and will own the walkthrough; I’ll loop in Karh to cover infra/security and Ava for the product bits.

Quick asks: can you share the IT contact (email) so we can include them on the invite, and do you have any must-cover items for the security checklist? We can run 30–45 minutes.

Proposed ET windows (all 45 min):
- Tue 2027-03-30 14:00–14:45 ET
- Wed 2027-03-31 15:00–15:45 ET
- Thu 2027-03-31 16:00–16:45 ET

If none work, we can shift later for Dublin overlap — just tell us which day/time zone would be best.

— Jasmine Liu
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — onboarding + security folks?

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and welcome. I’ll run the demo and Karthik will join for the security/network bit and to field any integration questions. Ava will show the trial setup and quick tips for reducing token costs.

I attached a short demo agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.docx) and, if you have it, please send the IT security contact or attach the questionnaire and we’ll prep answers ahead of time.

Two additional slots that work for our team and should hit your ET afternoon window:
- Tue 2027-03-30 14:30–15:15 ET (Karthik available)
- Wed 2027-03-31 16:00–16:45 ET (Karthik available)

If Dublin needs later overlap, we can do Wed 16:00 ET which is 21:00 Dublin — not ideal, so we’ll prioritize ET. Let me know which you prefer and I’ll send an invite.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
tel: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novacorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@novacorp.com>, trial-admin@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — onboarding + security folks?

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looping in our IT/security lead Ravi Patel (ravi.patel@novacorp.com). I’ve attached the standard questionnaire he uses (nova-security-questionnaire.pdf) — Ravi, high-level: we want to confirm network egress, data retention controls, and whether a private deployment option is needed for PII processing.

Quick note: our Dublin ops team is only available late afternoon local time (17:00–19:00 GMT), which means earlier ET slots work better for NovaCorp participants. The Tue 14:30 ET slot would actually translate to 19:30 GMT — okay but late. The Wed 16:00 ET slot is 21:00 GMT, too late. Could we propose Tue 13:00–13:45 ET (18:00–18:45 GMT) as an alternate?

Ravi — can you confirm if Tuesday 13:00 ET works and if you want any additional pre-call materials?

Thanks,
Elena

Attachment: nova-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 122KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novacorp.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — onboarding + security folks?

Hi Elena / Ravi —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. Quick read — we’ll be prepared to cover:
- Network: outbound-only egress to our hosted API endpoints; IP allowlisting options and VPC peering for Private deployments.
- Data: retention tiers, token-level redaction, and customer-managed KMS support.
- Audit: request/response logging and retention window options.

I can prep a short network diagram + a one-pager on retention controls before the call. Proposed confirmed slot: Tue 2027-03-30 13:00–13:45 ET — that hits your Dublin window and keeps it within our team’s afternoon.

If that works I’ll coordinate a calendar invite and include a short pre-read (network-diagram.png).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
